issue_context.title: Organizations avatars are identical
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): `Gitea version 1.14.0+dev-224-g586bfb9f3 built with GNU Make 4.3, go1.15.5 : bindata, sqlite, sqlite_unlock_notify`
- Git version: `git version 2.29.2.454.gaff20da3a2`
- Operating system: Arch Linux
- Built from:
  - [x] source
- Run with
  - [x] systemd
- Database:
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [x] Yes
  orgs `nuonepls` and `nuonepls2` of this user: https://try.gitea.io/poiuytre

## Description
I am not sure if this is the expected behaviour but the thing is that *some* orgs are displaying the same avatars as other orgs.
My screenshots show this behaviour for orgs by a single user, although on my instance I also have this avatar overlap with orgs of another user as well.

## Screenshots
